Myopia Control for Children in Pine Beach 

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

Does your child’s prescription seem to be changing every year? Myopia, or nearsightedness, is becoming more common in kids, especially with increased screen time and less time outdoors.

The good news is, there are ways to slow it down. At Academy Vision, we focus on more than just helping your child see clearly—we work to protect their vision for the future.

What It Means to be Nearsighted 

Myopia means your child can see things up close, but distant objects, like the board at school or signs far away, start to look blurry. This happens because the eye grows longer than it should, causing light to focus in the wrong place. As kids grow, their eyes can continue to change, which is why prescriptions often keep increasing over time.

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

Why Myopia Management Is Important

Glasses can help your child see clearly, but they don’t stop myopia from getting worse. As prescriptions increase, so does the risk of developing more severe eye conditions later in life.

By starting treatment early, we can help slow that progression and reduce those risks, giving your child a better chance at long-term eye health.

Call: (732) 978-9306

A Personalized Myopia Plan for Your Child

Every child is different, and their treatment should be too. We take the time to evaluate your child’s vision, lifestyle, and the rate at which their prescription is changing. From there, we’ll walk you through your options and help you choose a plan that fits your family. You’ll never feel rushed or overwhelmed—just informed and supported.

Book Appointment

Our Myopia Treatments

Once we understand your child’s vision, we’ll recommend options that are designed to slow progression. These may include:

  • Ortho-k (overnight lenses) that gently reshape the eye while your child sleeps, so they can see clearly during the day without glasses or contacts.
  • Soft contact lenses designed specifically for kids to help control how light enters the eye and slow prescription changes.
  • Atropine eye drops that are easy to use at home and help reduce how quickly myopia progresses.
  • Myopia control glasses with specialized lenses that support clearer vision while helping manage long-term changes.

What the Myopia Process Looks Like

Getting started is easier than you might think. We begin with a comprehensive eye exam to understand your child’s vision and how it’s changing. From there, we’ll talk through the best options and create a plan tailored to their needs. As your child grows, we’ll continue to monitor their progress and make adjustments along the way.

Book Appointment

Schedule a Myopia Evaluation in Pine Beach

If you’ve noticed your child’s vision changing, it’s worth taking a closer look. We’ll walk you through everything, answer your questions, and help you decide what makes the most sense moving forward. Give us a call or schedule your visit—we’ll take it from there.
